summary: A 1930 log crib ground cabin on a Lemhi County peak used for lookout work from the 1920s; abandoned in 1956, still standing, and reached on foot.

facts.status_note: Abandoned in 1956; the ground cabin still stands per the National Historic Lookout Register
facts.agency: US Forest Service - Salmon-Challis National Forest

events.note: A 1924 forest report describes a 9x9 house listed as a primary lookout (per Forest Lookouts)
September 1925 Salmon Herald item says a man had just returned after two months as lookout
10x10 log crib ground cabin replaced the earlier 6x6 cab and camp

evidence.supports: 10x10 log crib ground cabin replaced the structure in 1930
evidence.quote: The structure was replaced in 1930 with a 10x10 log crib ground cabin.
A 6x6 cabin and camp were constructed.
The site was abandoned in 1956. The structure remains standing.

evidence.supports: 1924 report of a 9x9 house listed as a primary lookout
evidence.quote: 1924: A Salmon Forest lookout report shows that this site had a 9x9 house and was listed as a primary lookout.

evidence.supports: a 1925 lookout posting of two months
evidence.quote: after an absence of two months as lookout on Taylor mountain

evidence.supports: 6x6 cab and camp in the 1920s; 1930 log crib cabin; abandoned 1956
elevation 9960 ft per Rex's Fire Lookout Page
Lemhi County, 24 miles southwest of Salmon
elevation 9960 ft per Idaho Fire Lookouts

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Not resolved from the pages read. NHLR gives 7,414 ft (2,260 m), which the record keeps; Rex's Fire Lookout Page and Idaho Fire Lookouts both give 9,960 ft. The story reports both.
NHLR and Rex's page describe a 6x6 cabin and camp in the 1920s; Forest Lookouts quotes a 1924 forest report describing a 9x9 house. The story reports both without choosing one.

The NHLR gives Salmon-Challis National Forest; Forest Lookouts, Rex's Fire Lookout Page and Idaho Fire Lookouts give Salmon National Forest. The story attributes the Salmon-Challis name to the register and reports the other name as what the other pages say.

notes_for_editor: The NHLR coordinates (N 43.306, W 111.921) fall outside Lemhi County and do not match the brief's lat/lon (44.885, -114.216). The Rex's page location (24 miles southwest of Salmon) fits the brief's coordinates, so the brief's coordinates were left alone; the NHLR coordinates look wrong. The elevation conflict (7,414 vs 9,960 ft) is not settled; check USGS before relying on either. Access and permission are not stated on any page read.
